# Extract user messages and first assistant conclusions from today's transcripts (mtime today)
python3 <<'PY'
import json, os, glob
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day = "2026-11-24"
roots = [
  "/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts",
  "/Users/mac/.dc-platform/memory/mirrors/agent-transcripts/old-mac",
  "/Users/mac/.dc-platform/memory/mirrors/agent-transcripts/new-mac",
]
seen = set()
for root in roots:
  if not os.path.isdir(root):
    continue
  for path in glob.glob(root + "/**/*.jsonl", recursive=True):
    # skip if not today-ish by mtime
    mtime = datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(path), TZ).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    # also check content timestamps
    msgs = []
    try:
      with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
          line=line.strip()
          if not line: continue
          try:
            o=json.loads(line)
          except: continue
          ts = o.get("timestamp") or o.get("createdAt") or ""
          role = o.get("role") or o.get("type") or ""
          # normalize content
          content = o.get("message",{}).get("content") if isinstance(o.get("message"),dict) else o.get("content")
          text=""
          if isinstance(content,str): text=content
          elif isinstance(content,list):
            parts=[]
            for c in content:
              if isinstance(c,dict) and c.get("type")=="text": parts.append(c.get("text",""))
              elif isinstance(c,str): parts.append(c)
            text="\n".join(parts)
          elif isinstance(o.get("text"),str): text=o["text"]
          if not text: continue
          # filter by day in ts if present
          day_hit = day in str(ts) or (not ts and mtime==day)
          if not day_hit and mtime!=day: continue
          if role in ("user","human") or o.get("type")=="user":
            msgs.append(("U", str(ts)[:19], text[:500].replace("\n"," ")))
          elif role in ("assistant",) and len(msgs)<8:
            # keep short assistant first lines for context
            first = text.strip().split("\n")[0][:200]
            if first: msgs.append(("A", str(ts)[:19], first))
    except Exception as e:
      continue
    # only keep if has user msgs mentioning day or mtime today
    user_msgs=[m for m in msgs if m[0]=="U"]
    if not user_msgs and mtime!=day: continue
    if mtime!=day and not any(day in m[1] for m in user_msgs):
      # check if any user text is substantial work today - still include if file mtime today
      if mtime!=day: continue
    key=os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(path))
    if key in seen: continue
    seen.add(key)
    print(f"\n=== {key} · mtime={mtime} · host_path={path.split('agent-transcripts')[-1][:60]} ===")
    for r,t,x in msgs[:12]:
      print(f"{r} [{t}] {x[:350]}")
PY
